```python
# scan_ams_supersession.py
import requests, re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
items = [
    'dehydrated apples','dehydrated apricots','dehydrated peaches','dehydrated pears','dehydrated prunes',
    'dehydrated onions','dehydrated potatoes','dehydrated peas','dehydrated spinach','dehydrated carrots',
    'dehydrated celery','dehydrated sweet corn','dehydrated bell peppers','dehydrated cabbage',
    'frozen peas','frozen spinach','frozen sweet corn','frozen carrots','frozen onions','frozen bell peppers',
    'frozen peaches','frozen apricots','frozen pears'
]

def query(item):
    url = f"https://www.ams.usda.gov/search?search_api_fulltext={item.replace(' ','+')}"
    r = requests.get(url, timeout=10)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(r.text, 'html.parser')
    text = soup.get_text(' ').lower()
    years = re.findall(r'(19|20)\d{2}', text)
    return max([int(y) for y in years]) if years else None

results = {}
for it in items:
    try:
        results[it] = query(it)
    except Exception:
        results[it] = None
print(results)
```
